comment: Worked for 2.5 years and that's it... it's tired! The light comes on and nothing else!

Two months after the warranty expired, the machine broke down. They estimated the repair at 5,500 rubles! And I had bought the Italian-assembled one! The machine itself was fine, though after washing I had to rinse again, but that can probably be said about any of them - the detergent doesn't rinse out well, even though I add it by the instructions and it's not some junk... And the authorized service center technician told me a lot of interesting things... There's no point overpaying for a European country of manufacture, no point buying machines over 12-15 thousand, and nowadays all manufacturers deliberately make machines to break sooner (on average every 3-4 years!!!), thereby stimulating demand for new ones... The only thing still alive in terms of real QUALITY is probably the German Miele (Bosch, by the way, has long since fallen behind, it went downhill), but they break too, even at a price of 100,000... Conclusion: buy a cheap washer, for 8-10 thousand, and DON'T GET TOO UPSET when after the 3-year Samsung warranty ends you suddenly have to throw it out and buy again :)

I've been using it for three weeks. No complaints, only positive emotions. But yesterday I loaded the machine with dishes, added the detergent and started closing the little lid, and it wouldn't close. I tried this way and that, but it wouldn't close. I looked closer and the lid had deformed for unclear reasons. I straightened it a bit and it closed. After the dishes were washed, I opened it right away and noticed the lid was soft as plasticine. Taking the chance, I straightened it right away. Everything seems fine now, but I really didn't like all this. Especially considering I always set the 50 degree mode - what if I set 70 degrees? Will everything inside melt and drain into the sewer? And it washes wonderfully, of course :-)
Guys, will this system unit be suitable for playing CS GO on medium settings?

I think the Yaris is a wonderful phone! It's pleasant to hold, with convenient buttons! Of course, it suits young people more, probably it was designed for that audience! Personally I see no drawbacks in this phone. I advise you to take it and not think twice!!!!!!!!
Bought 2 of these fans today! Terrible. The speed is not enough at all, it barely turns on, and only on speed 3; on the others it quickly stops, if it starts at all!!!

They brought the laptop; the build quality and design are 5+. I haven't pushed it much yet, and both memory slots are occupied, so if you want to upgrade, you'll have to put the 1 GB module in the nightstand :)

Bought this humidifier. It's noisy, and the backlight keeps me from sleeping at night. After 4 months the steam flow became noticeably weaker, I don't feel any ionization, and the fan died and started humming. Result: returned after 8 months.

The food processor is excellent. I've been using it for 2 years, mostly the meat grinder, mixer and vegetable slicer. In 2 years the only breakdown was my own fault. It was fixed quickly. One drawback: additional attachments aren't sold in our stores... I managed to get them only through acquaintances from Germany...

Excellent appliance. The auto shut-off is just lovely. Important for old ladies and children. The only thing is that the soleplate got a little dirty, but it didn't lose its properties. I decided not to clean it.

We looked at this model in the store today; at first we were tempted by the price and the number of attachments. But on closer inspection it turned out that the meat grinder attaches to the motor unit with some kind of half-dead plastic thread, i.e. it just screws into the body a half turn with a light motion of one hand and even when new it wobbles slightly. What will it be like in a year? I suspect this plastic part isn't covered by the warranty either, and replacing it would cost no less than a new meat grinder. As a result, during grinding, the metal grinder will simply fly out of the plastic body from time to time. Pay attention and draw your conclusions about whether you really need this pile of functions.
I've used it for over a year; the oven heated badly from the start, and now I have to set the time three or four times longer. It heats the dishes, not what's in them. I hate LG products!

My wife and I have been using it for several months now and are very happy, because we're renovating and there's a lot of dust; the washer not only removes all the dust but also humidifies the room. I recommend it to everyone. No one will regret it. It's worth its money.
high speed, low noise, acceptable price, high build quality, convenient to use

I was given a PSP for my birthday when I turned 14, and I must say it was the best gift ever! I started doing everything for it: had a friend flash it, bought a camera, a case, downloaded lots of games. Right now it's a lifesaver when you're in the hospital or traveling somewhere; it replaces my computer, I watch movies and even TV on it, or for example sit in the park browsing the internet. There are only two minuses: the small set of accessories and the delicate screen. I had to walk around the city looking for various accessories, since I'm not used to buying online, and as for the delicate screen - never mind, so it got scratched, I take it with me almost everywhere anyway.

I've used it for a week, no complaints. Assembled it quickly, everything is clear without instructions. Pros: it works silently even at the maximum third speed, telescopic tube, color scheme and a fairly large propeller. Cons: although it stands in place fine, it wouldn't hurt to make the legs more stable.
If they sold you junk, there's no need to slander it!!! Awesome display and the sensor is sensitive!! I think the thing is easily worth 2590!!!
Terrible, poor-quality build; I got one with an unsoldered ground, it doesn't really do its job, can freeze up and cut power in the sockets... In the end it burned out...
A huge minus - no radio. Otherwise it would have been a wonderful player.

A wonderful TV!!! Picture quality is top-notch, not inferior to plasma! The sound is bassy and full. The menu is clear, the settings are advanced. And most importantly, Malaysian assembly. I recommend it to EVERYONE!

The plasma is super for the price, quality is great, 1080 movies over HDMI are just super. USB plays avi, doesn't play mkv, the plasma's software can be updated, I use it as a home theater. The only thing I couldn't do was connect 5.1 speakers directly to the plasma.

I'll tell a story, you decide whether to buy or not... I have a K850 phone. I love drum music, in particular Grinda+ZigZag. So, it really bothered me that on their awesome track Fort Boyard my phone, with in-ear earphones that I took from an old Walkman W610... all tracks were fine, but this one played with no bass((   I forgot about this problem, and then I got a chance to buy an mp3 player; the store had little choice, and for certain reasons I had to buy there. This was the best one. I bought it, went out, put in the earphones and turned it on... crap!!!, then I took out my phone and looked it up online: 80-18000... I thought I'd have to sell it... I take the earphones out of the phone (remember, in-ear ones, the design is such that the small part with the speakers can be detached, there was a mini-jack) and plug those little wires into the mp3... hm... fine)))   I get home, load Fort Boyard, start listening on the same in-ear earphones, turn the bass to max on the equalizer, volume to max and wait... thinking there will be no bass again... and then my mind was blown O.O. I didn't expect such excellent bass, I literally sat with my mouth open...   online they write 80-18000 Hz, but that's with standard earphones, buy in-ear ones or others suited to the signal power and go ahead with the music! Rating 5-, because the button wobbles and you can press it in two directions at once ((( the only minus)

Bought 2 months ago. Before buying I had experience with an oven of this brand, only with a pull-out trolley. The H23AB540 model is very compact and stylish. Nothing superfluous. It bakes very well and evenly. New-generation thin-walled baking pans suit it especially well. If you bake in a cast iron pan, put it closer to the bottom of the oven. When finished, a slight hum is heard - that's it cooling down. But it doesn't strain the ear at all. It requires careful handling regarding oil drops getting on the bottom. The instructions say to clean with soapy water and vinegar, but for such stains that's not enough, or you have to wipe with a cloth for a very long time.

Overall not a bad gas hob. The surface is moderately easy to stain. If you buy a special cleaning product, it's easy to clean. One drawback - the stamping of the panel itself isn't quite even. But once you fix it to the countertop it's not noticeable.

We bought it more than 2 years ago as a gift for my mother. The meat grinder turned out to be good quality. It copes very well. If film wraps around the blade and the meat gets stuck, there's a 'reverse' button; press it and you can keep grinding. Later we bought one for ourselves too. I agree with Regina, the only minus is that when you grind vegetables they fly all over the place - you have to hold them at the sides with your hand. But I still like it, and I give it a 5.

Today my husband and I bought an electric can opener at M.Video; it opens cans super, bottles super, the minus of this model - it sharpens knives poorly. In principle we don't need that function, we're happy with the purchase. I recommend buying it.

A disgusting vacuum cleaner, we'd have been better off not buying it. I read reviews about how good and cool everything was. I was wrong not to listen to the salespeople in the store. First, the minus is that it smells awful; when the dust is damp it has a disgusting smell, you have to wash it constantly and rinse the sponge filter. After 5 cleanings the sponge turned into who knows what. Now I'll have to look for it at a service center somewhere, plus the HEPA filter has to be found too, they aren't sold in the store. The power is very low, half the dust stays on the floor. I understood one thing: there's nothing better than a bagged vacuum cleaner.

I've been using this vacuum cleaner for over eight months. I bought it out of sporting interest because it's a bagless vacuum - it leaves a mixed impression: on one hand there are no problems with bags, on the other the hassle of washing the Nero filter. Pros: light. With a clean filter it vacuums very strongly. Small size. Cons: loud. Short tube - by the time you clean the whole apartment your back starts to ache. If you haven't cleaned in a while and there's a lot of dust and dirt, the Nero filter clogs quickly, so it has to be washed after every major cleaning. I recommend it for a small apartment and for those who like to clean often and a little at a time.

Bought it 3 days ago, today I put it to the test, which it passed; the main course turned out simply super, the dessert was also very tasty. Everything baked evenly, I'm very happy with the purchase. Many functions, three trays, and convection is of course an indispensable part of any oven. Special thanks to the manager of the M.Video Europe City Mall store, I didn't remember his name, a very good manager who explains everything competently, and special thanks to the delivery team, they work efficiently and are never late. Thank you very much.

Simply super! Relatively thin, with big keys, a decent-sized screen and, as always, a convenient interface, and it even takes more or less decent photos! An excellent model for people whose phone isn't for games and ringtones but for getting things done!
